data.body: [P2] Replace the removed adapter CLI path with shared collection. The base CLI accepts `--collect` or `--collected-evidence` and rejects `--adapter`. This command therefore fails before collection, and the new `test_documented_lmi_commands_use_supported_flags` also deterministically fails because it requires this unsupported flag. Document `--collect` with a deployment-backed manifest and `FixtureBinding`, describe custom factories through the SDK-owned-suite Python API, and update the test to require `--collect`.
